notes:
Deal snapshot: Mid-market SaaS platform for vertical search/support (customer success focus). Evaluating Redwood hosted API first to accelerate POC; explicit path to Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation if POC metrics hit targets.

POC goals:
- Improve doc-search relevance (reranking + embeddings) across 12k articles
- Replace parts of current rule-based triage with a chat assistant for support agents (assist, suggest replies)
- Maintain p99 latency < 120ms for assistant completions for internal agent flows; 200ms acceptable for user-facing async search.

Cost sensitivity: High. Finance flagged expected 40%+ increase in monthly cloud GPU cost is a hard blocker — team asked for unit economics projection. In cost workshop, Redwood Optimize ran batch/caching scenarios and produced an estimated per-1M-token cost delta. Talon Skyline engineering comment: "we'll accept up to ~2% drop in NLU accuracy if it buys 30-50% cost reduction".

Technical preferences & constraints:
- Favor open models (Llama-3 family) with option for Redwood-curated quantized variants.
- Need KMS-backed key management for PII logs; legal requires audit log retention policy (90 days) and ability to set EU residency for European customers.
- SSO via SAML (Okta) + SCIM provisioning required for Dedicated onboarding.

POC runbook highlights:
- Traffic replay from production (anonymized) used for batching experiments.
- Caching: prefix cache looked promising for repeatable system prompts, reduced token spend by ~18% in sample run.
- Quantization: 4-bit profile reduced GPU footprint but introduced slight hallucination cases on long-context reranks; engineering wants additional evals on prompts where recall is critical.

Commercials & next steps:
- Demo pricing for Hosted API provided 2026-02-04; team requested Dedicated term sheet after cost workshop.
- Next immediate action: 2026-03-18 sizing call to align on expected committed capacity and guardrails for fallback routing (hosted -> dedicated).
- Blockers: procurement SLA language for uptime & liability, KMS proof of concept for VPC, explicit EU data residency mapping.

Steno from last call: "If Dedicated gets us predictable p95 throughput and a 35% drop in unit cost w/ acceptable QA loss, we can move forward with a 12-month commit".

Notes on competitors: evaluating Anthropic's hosted endpoints and an internal self-hosted inference stack; primary differentiation for Redwood is clear cost-tuning levers + unified routing for hosted->dedicated migration.
